## Record purchase (optional helper)
Point your checkout's webhook here (POST). It checks the `x-webhook-token` header, maps the payload, and upserts one row per `order_id + sku` into `purchases`.

A refund or dispute webhook for the same order flips `status`, and the gate stops delivering it.

meta.description: Optional helper: writes verified purchases from any checkout webhook into the purchases table.
